## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/channels/api.ex and new lib/zaq/channels/delivery_files.ex. Carry TrustedContext.from_event via existing bridge map; authorize with normalized context only. Shared with_prepared preparation normalizes valid Records, uses registered Materialization, preserves binary/declared encoding and filename/MIME, and scopes resources around consumer use. Prefer existing bytes; introduce owned paths only if needed.

## Tests to add before implementation
delivery_files_test.exs and API tests: exact non-UTF8 bytes, malformed/base64 content, metadata safety, missing/forged identity, source error, denied/revoked access, missing source, consumer error/exception and original file preservation. Property tests for exact-byte normalization. Conditional process-death cleanup test only if temp files introduced.

## Branches/paths validated
No files bypass preparation; supplied files materialize once. Pass actor but never connector credentials to source. Validate shape, not provider acceptance limits. Existing whole-content acquisition limitation remains #875.

## Mocking plan
Real materialization/domain routes; controlled external edges and supported per-call/event opts. No global env or fake production callbacks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse Materialization.materialize/4, handlers and NodeRouter. Local-only helper owns prepared resources, not source/provider dispatch or limits. Missing identity cannot elevate access; errors return through existing bridge contract.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.
